GENERATE BURST BV2-6 -- Run C-9 Phase 2, lane BV2: a LOOSE CONCEPT SKETCH of one burial mound (a barrow) for a winter game level. task_id "BV2-6".

SUBJECT: THE BURNT BARROW: a mound faced with a charred timber revetment of blackened upright planks, a few half-burned stakes leaning around it. Inside the doorway, a faint dull orange ember glow. Grey-black soot and ash smudged on the snow in front of the door; the snow around is otherwise clean.

FRAMING: ONE barrow only, centred, filling about two-thirds of the frame, its doorway facing the viewer, on open snowy ground with a little trodden snow and a few tufts of rust winter heather and dark juniper around it. Seen from a high three-quarter top-down view, about 53 degrees down, like a fixed overhead game camera. One low warm winter sun from the upper LEFT; short soft blue-violet shadows. No sky, no horizon.

HAND: a loose concept sketch, not a finished painting -- a varying dark warm-brown ink line (bolder on outer contours, lighter inside), transparent watercolour washes, cream paper left showing as the highlights, a cold winter palette of blue-white snow and warm grey stone with the warm low sun. Keep detail sparse and the big shape clear and readable at small size. IMAGE 1 is a reference for palette, light, snow and painted hand ONLY -- not its layout or its mound.

No characters, no creatures, no text, lettering, labels, UI, border or frame.

Exactly ONE image_gen call (generate, landscape 1536x1024). Do not retry inside this burst. Copy the output to out/BV2-6.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "BV2-6"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
